name: Edgegap
what_it_is: An automated game server hosting and orchestration service for any engine and service.
platforms: 615+ edge cloud locations; 58 bare metal locations
pricing: Edge cloud $0.00115 per vCPU per minute, billed on usage; Private Fleet bare metal $0.0261 per vCPU per hour ($280 per host per month on a 12 month rate, $350 monthly).

facts.fact: The homepage describes Edgegap as an automated game server hosting and orchestration service for any engine and service.
The pricing page lists edge cloud at $0.00115 per vCPU per minute, billed by the minute on usage, across 615+ locations, with $0.10 per GB of monthly egress and deployments from 0.25 to 4 vCPU.

The pricing page lists Private Fleet (bare metal) reserved capacity at $0.0261 per vCPU per hour, or $280 per host per month on a 12 month rate and $350 monthly, with 16 vCPU per host (14.7 usable), 58 locations and 6 TB of egress included per host per month.
The free trial on the pricing page is $0 with no credit card and offers 1.5 vCPU, 1 app with 2 versions and usage caps.
The pricing page lists reserved Private Fleet commitments of 1, 6 or 12 months and automatic overflow to edge cloud.
